sources.title: UniFi Redundant Power - Tech Specs
sources.evidence_note: Official specifications list one 1 GbE RJ45 management interface, six RPS DC output ports, and distinct maximum output rails of 52 V DC at 600 W and 11.5 V DC at 350 W. Rail ratings are separate static capacities, not one combined runtime power reading; no per-output rail assignment is inferred.

notes: The six RPS DC outputs are modeled separately from the single Ethernet management interface, without inferring per-output rail assignments. The 52 V/600 W and 11.5 V/350 W rail capacities remain separate; no combined capacity is calculated and no runtime state is stored in this Catalog model.
